rubric.why: Awards one mark for explaining what magnification describes.
rubric.description: Magnification describes how much larger an image appears compared with the actual object.
rubric.how: Look for a connection between magnification and image size, or between magnification and enlargement of the object.

rubric.why: Awards one mark for explaining what resolution describes.
rubric.description: Resolution is the ability to distinguish two close points as separate.
rubric.how: Look for the idea that resolution allows close points to be seen as separate.

modelAnswer: Magnification is how many times larger an image appears than the actual object.
Resolution is the ability to distinguish two close points as separate.

rubric.why: Awards one mark for describing chromatin’s form and when it is present in that form.
rubric.description: Chromatin is long, thin, thread-like genetic material in the nucleus during interphase.
rubric.how: Look for its thread-like form and its association with interphase.

rubric.why: Awards one mark for describing chromosomes as condensed structures visible during cell division.
rubric.description: Chromosomes are condensed forms of chromatin that become visible during cell division.
rubric.how: Look for condensation or visibility of chromosomes during cell division.

modelAnswer: Chromatin is the long, thin, thread-like form of genetic material in the nucleus during interphase.
Chromosomes are condensed forms of chromatin that become visible during cell division.
